items.title: Budget and booking gate
items.location: Booking review
items.description: Do not treat the INR 180,000 cap as met. Flight plus hotel equals INR 173,988, leaving INR 6,012. Even using mostly free attractions, this remainder must cover all meals, MRT rides and the mandatory overnight airport car, and any baggage fee would be additional. Paid conservatories and museums would raise the total further. Before booking, confirm: (1) 20 kg checked baggage for each adult and total fare after baggage; (2) one genuinely private double/queen room and final tax-inclusive hotel total; and (3) MRT proximity. If any adds cost, increase the budget or replace the saved flight/hotel through a new live search with an extended search allowance.
